title: Used Car Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Used Vehicle Inspection: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Used Car Inspection Checklist covers vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input. The vehicle inspection coordinator records Used Vehicle Inspection criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Used Car Inspection Checklist keeps Used Vehicle Inspection exceptions visible until the vehicle inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Used Car Inspection Checklist at inspection facility, lift bay, controlled test route, and document review area. Document vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input identity before Used Vehicle Inspection begins. Compare vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input findings with stated Used Vehicle Inspection criteria; route unresolved Used Vehicle Inspection issues to qualified independent automotive reviewer. For Used Car Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Used Vehicle Inspection. Ask qualified independent automotive reviewer to review Used Vehicle Inspection conditions beyond the vehicle inspection coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Used Vehicle Inspection, identify responsible parties, inspection facility, lift bay, controlled test route, and document review area, and the linked vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input source.

fields.label: VIN, plate, year, make, model, and mileage
History, title, service-record, and listing references

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Used Vehicle Inspection facts for vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Used Vehicle Inspection checks
items: Body, glass, structure, paint, and prior-repair indicators
Engine, transmission, cooling, fuel, and exhaust operation
Brakes, steering, suspension, tires, and wheels
Electrical, controls, safety features, and accessories
Road test, scan, leaks, measurements, and inspection limitations

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Before closing Used Vehicle Inspection, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Vehicle Inspection Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Finding presented as guarantee or valuation without basis
blocks.guidance: Pause Used Vehicle Inspection when identity, safe testing, access limitation, material defect, or communication boundary remains unresolved. Retain the available Used Vehicle Inspection proof and route unresolved vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input scope to vehicle inspection coordinator.
